$comment: C3/D2 — the environment registry. Declares which environments exist, what each is FOR,
and where its deployed frontend can be read. Consumed by scripts/checkDeployedVersions.mjs
to answer 'what SHA should this environment be running, and does deployed == expected?'.
READ-ONLY DECLARATION. Nothing here provisions, deploys, renames, or mutates any
infrastructure. Adding an entry does not create an environment; it records one that exists
or is planned, so drift against it can be observed.
DELIBERATE MODELLING DECISION: 'production' is NOT synonymous with Taylor Parts.
An environment has a `role` (what it is for) and a `deployment` (whose instance it is).
Platform environments are operated by the platform for building the platform; customer
deployments are per-operating-company. Today exactly one customer deployment exists, but
the registry must not encode that as a permanent assumption — see docs/DeploymentModeStrategy.md
(tenancy is a design objective, NOT implemented) and docs/PlatformCapabilityModel.md §5a.
Company/brand identity is deliberately NOT expressed here. `operator` uses a neutral
architectural placeholder; brand foundation is a separate workstream and this file must not

environments.purpose: Isolated platform development against the Firebase Emulator Suite. Synthetic data only, no production credentials.
environments.notes: Exists informally as local emulator use (docs/DevelopmentSetup.md). Not a deployed, addressable environment — no stable URL to observe.

environments.purpose: Integrated, non-production environment where a complete build can be exercised and reviewed before it becomes a release candidate.
environments.notes: DOES NOT EXIST. Its absence is why production is currently the only place the integrated frontend can be exercised, contrary to the promotion lifecycle (AI_ENGINEERING_OPERATING_MODEL.md §7). Tracked as the Sandbox/Integration Environment program; Supplier Master is already waiting on it for Owner experience review.

environments.purpose: First customer production deployment of Enterprise Operations OS.

surfaces.notes: Owner-authorized, evidenced releases. SPA catch-all rewrite returns 200 + text/html for ANY unmatched path, so manifest ABSENCE cannot be detected by status code — the checker validates content, never status alone.
Auto-publishes on merge to main, outside the promotion lifecycle. Recorded as an open governance gap (R-2); this registry observes it, and does not change it.
